title: TaskAdmitted
description: The payload of task.admitted/v1 (M1 slice plan §1 admission; D51; I22): the controller admitted a task from Ready, in the command that records its template's first nodes after it. internal/authority admits it only under its task's id and project, by a live system actor at its event's time, of a task in Ready whose approval (the one named here) is in force, while no other admitted task is non-terminal, a held one included.
